attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
description: BLS public Consumer Price Index release schedule: Schedule of Selected Releases annual pages (bls.gov/schedule/{YYYY}/), the current CPI schedule page (bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm), the archived CPI news releases page (bls.gov/bls/news-release/cpi.htm) and the 2025 shutdown impact FAQ
permission_basis: Public release schedule data published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, free to use; the pages require no API key. Used for research only; raw payloads are not redistributed. BLS returns HTTP 403 to direct programmatic requests, so the calendar was transcribed from the schedule pages via text fetch and cross-checked (see research/macro-windows-006/cpi_calendar.json). This registry entry is an explicit research-use assertion, not a legal determination.
timestamp_basis: CPI release dates are public in advance (the annual schedule is announced months ahead); every release is 08:30 Eastern Time (12:30 UTC in daylight saving time, 13:30 UTC in standard time), always before the 16:00 ET close, so a release on date D is knowable at the close of D.
